label: orchestrator • a question about the code project goes to Builder
query: Look at my code project and tell me what changed in the last few commits.
notes: Developer-Mac team: Planner, Courier, Keeper, Scout and Builder, created from the bundled templates in a scratch folder. Builder owns the project folder and takes the Code worker's asks while it is on the team, so the Orchestrator calls `run_workflow` with "Builder". The scratch folder is not a git repository; this case scores the route, not Builder's answer.
